name: qfd_tile_nk_tp8-r1-COMMIT
purpose: qwen-tp8 TP8 parameter setting of the die tile qfd_tile_nk (r22ko4 D2 NK variant): GT 6144 -> 3072 (768 tiles/die, CODE_BANKS 5, same 10 ROM macros + 8 lsl leaves, same faces); ref_tile cluster floorplan 311.04 x 1291.656 (ROM 2x(3+2) bands with 20 um channels, leaves on the 43.2 lattice). Gate: partition bench at the TP8 analog GT 24 (3*2^k like 3072) seeds 1/5 + GT 8 PASS; TMUT 3/4/5 (stale MPR copy / stale-2*GT round step / per-round count) FAIL.
